episodes.summary: Marcus, a software engineer at Anthropic working on inference infrastructure, is experiencing burnout due to an intense and brutal on-call rotation while his teammate Wei is on vacation.

Marcus discussed his deep interest in Roman history, specifically the Crisis of the Third Century and Diocletian's Tetrarchy, sharing that his friend Priya influenced his perspective on the decline of the empire.
Marcus is planning a spring trip to Rome with his partner Elena while navigating a career transition offer from his current infrastructure team to the alignment safety team at Anthropic.
Marcus has decided to proceed with his team transfer and confirmed travel plans for his upcoming trip to Rome with Elena.
